visualizerParams.title: Code Refactor: Radio group in a fieldset
visualizerParams.problemDescription: These radio buttons float without a heading. Group them in a fieldset with a legend. Same buttons, same names.
visualizerParams.initialCode: Pick a colour

solution.code:
<fieldset>
  <legend>Pick a colour</legend>
  <label><input type="radio" name="c" id="r" checked> Red</label>
  <label><input type="radio" name="c" id="g"> Green</label>
</fieldset>
solution.explanation: A fieldset with a legend names a group of controls. A screen reader says "Pick a colour, group" before each radio button, so the buttons make sense without seeing the page.
